status: SOURCE INVENTORY AND PROPOSAL ONLY; no derivative or export created; consumer contract pending

execution.method: Raw mesh datablocks counted once. Each city object evaluated from dependency graph; native loop triangulation counted. Dependency-graph placements sum triangles per placement. Exact local-resource fingerprints include positions, triangle indices/order/material-index layout, smooth flags, corner normals and UV data; material-bound uniqueness additionally includes material slot names/order. No tolerance-based deduplication or translation/rotation normalization.
execution.count_limits: Static VIEWPORT evaluation; all 98 modifiers have matching viewport/render flags and are Bevel or Solidify. This is full assembled physical-city geometry, not frame visibility, GLB primitives/bytes, draw calls, decoded GPU memory or a budget. Resource uniqueness is conservative exact-content equality, not a proposed GPU-instancing result.
execution.checks: Two independent placed-count passes agree; family and material triangle sums agree; source checksum unchanged. Installed dynamic format enum resolved directly; no exporter called.

assembly.native_axes: Right-handed Blender +Z up. Reference view approaches city from negative Y; preserve origin and all source placements.
assembly.proposed_export_axes: glTF right-handed +Y up via exporter once; world coordinate relation (x,y,z)_Blender -> (x,z,-y)_glTF
assembly.contract: Preserve each evaluated local mesh with its exact matrix_world, OR bake matrix_world once for a derived batch and use identity node transforms. Never both. Preserve inverse-transpose normal transforms for the 96 nonuniformly scaled objects. No recentering/normalization or extra loader axis rotation. Consumer placement is a separate single parent transform not yet settled.
assembly.runtime_camera_or_fit: Not measured or authorized here; reference camera is not game camera.

materials.surface_graph: Every used material is a constant Principled BSDF linked directly to Material Output Surface. No surface image/procedural texture, shader group, normal map or vertex-color graph.
materials.uv_note: 153 mesh objects have a single UVMap; 5215 have none. These are not certified unique bake layouts. No bake is needed merely to transfer constant materials.
materials.role_status: Proposed functional labels for consumer agreement, not palette replacement or permission to collapse source variants.

effects.compositor: Scene compositing_node_group=None, bpy.data.node_groups empty; legacy use_nodes=True alone does not indicate an active compositor.
effects.portability: Principled Volume fog and camera-ray-split procedural worlds are not glTF surface materials. Area lights have no KHR_lights_punctual equivalent. Preserve their roles/profile as sidecar reference; exclude them from physical city GLB selection, with consumer atmosphere/lighting appearance handled explicitly later.

dependencies.weak_reference_note: Both are local unused-by-city materials, not loading dependencies. Exact source retains history; assigned-material derivative need not include these datablocks.

reuse.caution: Exact reuse is small. Repeated-looking world-baked architectural motifs were not normalized or reconstructed; no broad GPU-instancing saving is claimed.
reuse.batching_candidate: Geometry-preserving static concatenation by exact source material within spatial/family partitions, after consumer mapping/culling needs are known. Preserve per-triangle materials, split normals and source-object provenance. Current 6644 nonempty object/material triangle groups are not measured draw calls.

export_format.description: Dynamic enum inspected via installed io_scene_gltf2.get_format_items; no export invoked.

export_unused_images.description: Export images not assigned to any material

export_unused_textures.description: Export image texture nodes not assigned to any material. This feature is not standard and needs an external extension to be included in the glTF file

at_collection_center.description: Export at Collection center of mass of root objects of the collection

export_extras.description: Export custom properties as glTF extras

export_apply.description: Apply modifiers (excluding Armatures) to mesh objects -WARNING: prevents exporting shape keys

export_shared_accessors.description: Export Primitives using shared accessors for attributes

export_animations.description: Exports active actions and NLA tracks as glTF animations

export_lights.description: Export directional, point, and spot lights. Uses "KHR_lights_punctual" glTF extension

export_gpu_instances.description: Export using EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing. Limited to children of a given Empty. Multiple materials might be omitted

export_original_specular.description: Export original glTF PBR Specular, instead of Blender Principled Shader Specular

will_save_settings.description: Store glTF export settings in the Blender project
